one_liner: Shared inbox for small support teams with AI drafts trained on your own past replies.
description: replydeck is a shared support inbox for teams of two to ten agents. It drafts replies in your team's actual voice by learning from resolved conversations, keeps assignment and collision detection dead simple, and skips the enterprise workflow machinery that makes Zendesk feel heavy. Email-first, with a widget and a Slack bridge.
target_user: Support leads at small SaaS and e-commerce companies

icp.who: Support leads and founders handling 500-20,000 tickets a month with a small team
icp.pain: Zendesk and Intercom price and configure like enterprise software, while plain Gmail collapses once two people answer the same inbox
icp.buying_trigger: Second support hire starts and reply collisions or missed tickets become a weekly embarrassment

differentiators: AI drafts are trained on your own resolved tickets, so they sound like your team, not a generic bot
Five-minute setup by forwarding an address — no workflow configuration required
Flat, predictable per-seat pricing with every feature included
proof_points: Cut first-response time 40% on average across a 9-team pilot cohort
Largest customer handles 20,000 tickets/month on the standard plan

voice.sample_phrase: Answer faster, in your own voice — not a bot's.

confidence.notes: Pilot metrics are specific and dated on the site. SOC 2 claim verifiable via trust page.
